notes: Proposed WoW: Forever builds derived from the Classic baselines and the BlizzCon 2026 demo trees (captured 2026-09-13). Lightning Mastery, Elemental Mastery, Improved Weapon Totems and Weapon Mastery no longer exist; Mana Tide is now a 16-point talent. Point math is validated; performance is not.

builds.name: Enhancement — Stormstrike / Maelstrom Weapon (simulator winner adopted 2026-09-27)
builds.summary: Allocation adopted on 2026-09-27 from `opt-enhancement-dps-raid-dps`, the best build in the community simulator (+2.8% DPS vs the previous draft with the simulator's gear, rotation and buffs; the previous draft is kept under raid/raidsim/candidates/). Core talents are ranked by the simulator's removal cost. Previous summary: Improved Weapon Totems, Enhancing Totems and Weapon Mastery are gone, so Enhancement stops being a totem-support spec and becomes a melee DPS: Stormstrike at 16 points, Flurry, Mental Dexterity (AP from Intellect), Elemental Weapons, Spirit Weapons (parry + threat control), Mental Quickness, Improved Stormstrike, Maelstrom Weapon (instant Lightning Bolts) and the Rage of the Farseer capstone (+30% attack and cast speed). Concussion/Reverberation for shocks, Tidal Focus for hit.

core.why: New: melee hits stack -4%/rank cast time and mana on the next Lightning Bolt (5 stacks) — instant Lightning Bolts between swings. Raid sim (2026-09-27): the simulator's rotation reads this talent's own proc, so its removal run breaks the rotation and is not its value.
Now the 16-point talent: weapon strike + 20% Nature damage taken for 12s. Raid sim (2026-09-27): removing it costs +19% DPS.
Haste after crits (demo rank 1 = 5%); requires Mental Dexterity 3. Raid sim (2026-09-27): removing it costs +10% DPS.
+5% crit with all spells and attacks. Raid sim (2026-09-27): removing it costs +5% DPS.
-45% shock/Lightning Shield mana. Raid sim (2026-09-27): removing it costs +5% DPS.
Capstone: +30% melee and casting speed for 25s every 3 minutes. Raid sim (2026-09-27): removing it costs +4% DPS.
New: attack power from Intellect (33%/rank read). Raid sim (2026-09-27): removing it costs +4% DPS.
Raid sim (2026-09-27): removing it costs +3% DPS.

alternatives: any utility talent legal at that tier
flex.why: Measures +0.3% DPS in the community simulator (noise): these points are free to move.

notes: Adopted from the community simulator on 2026-09-27: `opt-enhancement-dps-raid-dps` beat the previous draft by +2.8% DPS; the rationale below predates the adoption where it names talents no longer taken.
Two-Handed Axes and Maces is no longer a talent — check whether shamans can still use two-handers baseline; this build assumes dual wield or a two-hander with Windfury either way.
Windfury Totem can no longer be improved — the melee-group support reason for bringing an Enhancement shaman is gone; the spec must stand on its own DPS.
Beta client: Tidal Mastery is a tier-4 talent now, so the Restoration dip is Totemic Focus 5 (tier 1) plus Tidal Focus 5.

2026-09-27 scenario audit: Improved Stormstrike 2 -> Elemental Devastation 2. Improved Stormstrike resets Stormstrike when you dodge or parry and adds regen while casting: behind a raid boss you are never attacked, and the simulator measures 0.0%. Elemental Devastation turns Flame Shock and Earth Shock crits into +9% melee crit for 10 s (simulator +3.1% on the optimizer build).
open_questions: Dual wield for shamans (implied by Predator's Edge-style talents elsewhere, not confirmed here).
Maelstrom Weapon proc rate; Mental Dexterity/Quickness scaling at max rank.

builds.name: Elemental / Nature's Swiftness (PvP, 30/0/21)
builds.summary: Reverberation (shock cooldown), Elemental Fury crits, Lightning Overload, Earthbound (Earthbind roots) and Elemental Alacrity in Elemental; Nature's Swiftness, Tidal Focus, Mindfulness and Water Shield in Restoration. Lava Burst is one point out of reach — the Classic 30/0/21 dilemma remains.

core.why: Instant Chain Lightning/Lightning Bolt burst or instant Healing Wave.
-1s shock cooldown (est.) — Frost Shock kiting, Earth Shock interrupts.
Double crit damage.
New: Earthbind Totem roots for 5s on placement.
Free extra bolts.
Hit.
Mana while being hit.
Cast through damage.

notes: 31/0/20 with Lava Burst instead of Nature's Swiftness is the burst-over-utility alternative.
Build 1.60.1.70009 moved Elemental Alacrity to tier 3 and made it Call of Thunder's prerequisite (3/3): Eye of the Storm drops to 1 to fill Alacrity.

builds.name: Leveling — Enhancement (Stormstrike at 25, Rage of the Farseer at 40)
builds.summary: Classic Enhancement leveling reached Stormstrike at 40; in Forever it is the 16-point talent, so it lands at 25. Thundering Strikes (now crit with everything) first, Mental Dexterity (AP from Intellect, and the Flurry prerequisite), Shamanistic Focus at 20 for cheap shocks, Elemental Weapons, Stormstrike, Flurry, Improved Stormstrike (mana regen), Mental Quickness, Maelstrom Weapon (instant Lightning Bolts) and Rage of the Farseer at 40. Then Concussion/Reverberation for shocks and Tidal Mastery/Tidal Focus for hit. Ends in the Forever Enhancement raid build.

core.why: +5% crit with all spells and attacks — better than Classic's melee-only version, so it stays first.
New: AP from Intellect (33%/rank read — scaling unclear) and the Flurry prerequisite.
New 1-pointer at 20: shocks and Lightning Shield cost 45% less — mana was the Classic Enhancement leveling problem.
Windfury Weapon +13%/rank (est. 40%) from 30 when Windfury is learned; Rockbiter before.
16-pt at 25 (Classic: 40): weapon strike + 20% Nature damage taken for shocks.
Haste after crits (demo rank 1 = 5%; est. 25%).
New: 50% chance for 50% mana regen while casting after Stormstrike — the sustain talent.
New: melee hits stack a cheaper/faster Lightning Bolt (5 stacks) — instant bolts to open or finish.
Capstone at 40: +30% attack and cast speed for 25s every 3 minutes.
+5% hit with everything (est.) — last because it needs 5 Restoration filler points first.

alternatives: Improved Ghost Wolf 2 (indoors Ghost Wolf, 1.0s faster) and respec at 60
flex.why: Improved Ghost Wolf is the best quality-of-life pick while leveling; it is not in the 60 build.

notes: Loop: Stoneskin/Strength of Earth totem, Stormstrike -> Earth Shock (Shamanistic Focus makes it cheap) -> auto-attack with Windfury; Maelstrom Lightning Bolt to pull from 35.
Two-Handed Axes and Maces is no longer a talent — if two-handers are baseline, Windfury on a slow two-hander is still the leveling weapon; if not, dual wield.
Beta client: Tidal Mastery is a tier-4 talent now, so the Restoration dip is Totemic Focus 5 (tier 1) plus Tidal Focus 5.

Fight lab (leveling/fightlab/enhancement-dps.md, 2026-09-28, generated by render_fightlab_sections.py): time per kill at L20/30/40/50/60 = 21/29/33/36/37 s with Classic 1.12 creature stats and quest greens; the optimizer's opt-enhancement-dps-leveling-st is +0% at 60 and -1% at 30 (negative = faster); race winner over the leveling: leveling-enhancement; top talents at 60: Shamanistic Focus +13%, Stormstrike +9%, Mental Dexterity +5%, Thundering Strikes +4%; about zero: Concussion, Guardian Totems, Improved Ghost Wolf, Reverberation. See the Fight lab section of leveling/README.md.
open_questions: Mental Dexterity and Mental Quickness scaling at max rank (only rank 1 read).
